Acitretin is used alone or with PUVA (a psor- alen with UVA irradiation) or UVB in psoriasis1-4 (p.1583). Stud- ies have shown that use with PUVA or UVB light may increase efficacy and allow a reduction in the exposure to radiation re- quired. It is also used in keratinisation disorders such as severe forms of ichthyosis1,5-7 (p.1580) and Darier’s disease (keratosis follicularis)1,8 (p.1578). Benefit has been reported in various oth- er skin disorders including lichen planus (p.1580), lichen sclero- sus (p.1580), and cutaneous lupus erythematosus (p.1513).1 1. Berbis P. Acitretin.
